artifact_review: The Router identified two artifacts: texture anomaly (haloing) and structural collapse (rear paw fusion). I agree with the severity ratings. The haloing is minor (1.5), typical of AI generation against complex backgrounds. The rear paw issue (2.0) is more significant; the Pose Auditor's low confidence in the left knee (hind limb) corroborates the Router's observation of ambiguity/fusion in the rear leg area. The Perceptual Quality Auditor also noted moderate compression artifacts, which adds to the overall noise/graininess but doesn't indicate structural failure. The Topology Boundary Auditor's high mask confidence suggests the main body is coherent, but it cannot rule out the subtle fusion at the paws which the Router correctly flagged. No new catastrophic artifacts were found by experts, but the cumulative effect of minor issues (haloing, paw fusion, compression) prevents a perfect score.
